abstract: PURPOSE: Sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) is a rare congenital tumor originating from a variant of extragonadal germ cell neoplasm. Herein, we present three cases of neonatal SCTs undergoing surgical resection and reconstruction. We also review the literature to discuss the importance of proper perinatal management and timely surgical intervention depending on the tumor type and maturity to prevent malignant transformation and recurrence and ensure functional outcomes. METHODS AND RESULTS: Three cases of SCT were retrospectively analyzed. All infants underwent complete surgical resection of the SCT and coccygectomy during their neonatal/infancy period, followed by pelvic floor and buttock reconstruction while minimizing buttock contour deformity and undesirable skin scar. Two of the cases were histopathologically diagnosed as predominantly cystic mature teratomas of Altman types I and IV, and the third was a mature teratoma of Altman type II. There were no complications or tumor recurrence during the average follow-up period of 5.3 years. CONCLUSIONS: This case-based review highlights the role of multidisciplinary team approaches, including prenatal monitoring, oncologic resection, and adequate reconstruction according to the type of tumor and anomaly. Optimal perinatal evaluation allows promising oncologic and functional outcomes in terms of timely intervention to eliminate tumor recurrence and malignant transformation. Complete oncologic surgical resection of SCTs should also include proper functional preservation strategies, such as the reconstruction of the pelvic floor, cosmetic buttock contouring, and preservation of bladder and bowel sphincter function.
abstract_ja: 目的：仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)は、性腺外胚細胞性腫瘍の一亜型に由来する、まれな先天性腫瘍である。本稿では、新生児SCTの3症例を提示し、外科的切除と再建について述べる。また、腫瘍の種類と成熟度に応じて適切な周産期管理と適時の外科的介入を行い、再発や悪性転化を予防し機能的転帰を確保することの重要性について、文献をレビューする。方法と結果：SCT 3症例を後方視的に解析した。全例で、新生児期または乳児期に、SCTの完全外科的切除と尾骨切除を実施し、続いて骨盤底と殿部の再建を行い、殿部の輪郭の変形と望ましくない皮膚瘢痕を最小限に抑えた。2例は組織学的に、Altman I型およびIV型の主に嚢胞性の成熟奇形腫と診断され、3例目はAltman II型の成熟奇形腫であった。平均5.3年の追跡期間中に合併症や腫瘍再発は認められなかった。結論：本症例ベースのレビューは、腫瘍の種類と奇形に応じた、出生前モニタリング、腫瘍学的切除、適切な再建を含む多職種チームアプローチの役割を強調する。最適な周産期評価により、腫瘍の再発や悪性転化を排除するための適時の介入という点で、腫瘍学的および機能的な転帰の改善が期待できる。SCTの完全な腫瘍学的外科的切除には、骨盤底の再建、殿部輪郭の整容的形成、膀胱および腸の括約筋機能の保存といった、適切な機能温存の方策も含めるべきである。
